scope: Local evidence-framing presentation view; separate from semantic topic embeddings and not a new manuscript result.
source_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({'paper_ids': ids, 'score_axes': payload['focus_axes'], 'scores': [[p['scores'][a] for a in axes] for p in papers]}, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(',', ':')); original payload numeric values are preserved.
paper_order: Exact canonical atlas paper_axis_index order. Neighbor indices address this order.

projection.input_scaling: Existing five corpus-standardized scores; no whitening or re-standardization.
projection.orientation_convention: Native seeded UMAP coordinates; no post-fit rotation, centering, or per-coordinate scaling.

parameter_comparison.selection_rule: Highest selection-query mean exact-neighbor recall@15 among configurations with an improvement of at least0.02 over PCA, trustworthiness no worse than PCA minus0.001, and no top-decile axis group recall regression worse than0.02. Trustworthiness breaks exact recall ties. A second seed is fitted only for the selected parameter setting. Selection ignores visual islands and theory purity.
parameter_comparison.validation_note: The disjoint validation query sample is withheld from parameter selection, but all corpus points participate in every unsupervised fit. This tests neighbor robustness, not out-of-sample generalization.
parameter_comparison.diagnostic_definition: Top-k Euclidean neighbors of rounded six-decimal 3D coordinates are compared with exact Euclidean neighbors in the original five scores. Trustworthiness uses original ranks among every other corpus paper. Both query samples contain512 papers.
parameter_comparison.input_file_hashes_note: These are historical input snapshots captured before the comparison, not assertions about current live paths. In particular, the two framing JSON inputs were PCA artifacts at commit 1fab45d and have since been replaced by UMAP artifacts; their preserved copies are identified below.

interpretation: The six-configuration sweep selected 15 neighbors and min_dist 0.1 by overall exact-neighbor recall, with safeguards across all five top-decile score groups, not by visual islands or theory purity.
A second seed and a disjoint query sample confirmed the global improvement. All corpus papers still participated in each unsupervised fit; this is not out-of-sample generalization.

Improvements are not universal. The selected seed's selection-query theory recall fell 1.36 percentage points; validation-query resource recall fell 2.27 points (50 queries). Other validation groups improved.

The selected seed's example top-10 overlaps changed from 7 to 6 for Frank-Wolfe and 4 to 3 for algorithmic stability; FineWeb and episodic RL remained 7. Original five-score related-paper lists are unchanged.
All framing layouts remain continuous clouds or bands. UMAP provides a broader curved shape and better local fidelity, not evidence of discrete paper categories.

neighbor_definition: Ten exact nonself Euclidean neighbors in all five existing corpus-standardized scores, equally weighted, computed exhaustively in float64. Canonical row index resolves distance ties. These describe evidence-framing similarity, not topic similarity.

diagnostics.query_sampling: Fixed random query sample from the fitted corpus; not held-out data or a generalization test.
diagnostics.definition: Top-15 exact neighbor recall and rank-penalty trustworthiness against original five-score Euclidean distances, using every other corpus paper as a candidate; evaluates the six-decimal coordinates actually exported.

high_theory_group_sanity_check.definition: At or above the existing corpus-wide formal-theory score 90th percentile, ties included; this is not a proof-content label.

limitations: This view groups similar values on five operational evidence-framing scores, not research topics, full-paper proof content, or scientific quality.
For PCA, variance retained is not the proportion of exact neighbors preserved. For UMAP, global distances, density, gaps, and apparent group sizes are not faithful measurements of the original space.
Use the exact original five-score neighbor list for similar framing; nearby projected points are approximate.
The five axes coexist, are correlated, and share an embedding-based measurement method. Equal weighting does not make them independent evidence sources.
Coordinates do not define discrete paper categories. No labels or targets were used to force clusters; the framing distribution remains a continuous band.
Framing and topic layouts use different input spaces and metrics; their diagnostic values are not a controlled head-to-head comparison of algorithms.
High-theory neighborhood enrichment is a descriptive input-space check, not independent validation that a paper contains formal proofs.
